title: Inefficient root-finding for noise approximation
description: The theoretical insights are agnostic to particular algorithms of root-finding for the noise term, making it possible to use more efficient solutions in future research, e.g., training diffusion models as invertible maps to sample noise faster.
canonical_description: root-finding for noise approximation in score distillation could be made more efficient
